card.name: Same time every day
card.fires_on: The word "time" in "at the same time" before "each day" or "every day" in dosing directions. Also clock-time endings such as the last digit of 22:31 or "hours" after 0600.

modes.label: Same time daily
modes.description: "time" in "at about the same time" just before each/every/daily.
modes.example: Administer KOMZIFTI orally at about the same<< time>> each day.

modes.label: Clock times
modes.description: The end of a clock time or the word hours in a time stamp.

card.writes: It pushes toward day-related words such as today, every day, tomorrow and tonight.
card.plain: It fires when text says to do something at the same time each day, or gives a clock time.
